name: p4_lem1_i
informal: Lemma 1(i): for positive integers a <= n <= b, z(a)-(r(b)+1)m(b) <= x(n) <= z(b)-(r(a)+1)m(a).
original: Let a ≤ n ≤ b be positive integers. (i) z(a)-(r(b)+1)m(b) ≤ x(n) ≤ z(b)-(r(a)+1)m(a).
type: ∀ (a b n : ℕ), 0 < a → a ≤ n → n ≤ b → Mathlib2.p4_z a - (↑(Mathlib2.p4_r b) + 1) * ↑(Mathlib2.p4_m b) ≤ Mathlib2.p4_x n ∧ Mathlib2.p4_x n ≤ Mathlib2.p4_z b - (↑(Mathlib2.p4_r a) + 1) * ↑(Mathlib2.p4_m a)
